protocol.name: Ni-NTA purification of His-tagged EGFR extracellular domain
protocol.purpose: Purify secreted His-tagged EGFR extracellular domain from clarified HEK293 conditioned medium and exchange the eluate into PBS for downstream binding assays.
materials: Clarified HEK293 conditioned medium containing His-tagged EGFR ECD
Binding buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 300 mM NaCl, 10 mM imidazole, pH 7.4
Wash buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 300 mM NaCl, 25 mM imidazole, pH 7.4
Elution buffer: 20 mM sodium phosphate, 300 mM NaCl, 250 mM imidazole, pH 7.4
0.22 µm filter, collection tubes, and ice

steps.text: Keep the clarified conditioned medium and all collected fractions on ice.
Equilibrate 2 mL Ni-NTA resin with 10 column volumes of binding buffer.
Adjust the conditioned medium to 10 mM imidazole, load at approximately 1 mL/min, and retain the flow-through.
Wash with 15 column volumes of wash buffer or until A280 returns to baseline.
Elute with 5 column volumes of elution buffer, collecting 1 mL fractions.
Screen fractions by A280 and SDS-PAGE; pool the EGFR-containing fractions.
Concentrate the pool to approximately 2 mg/mL using a 10 kDa MWCO concentrator at 4 °C.
Exchange into PBS with three concentration/dilution cycles.
Measure A280, record final concentration and yield, aliquot, snap-freeze, and store at -80 °C.

protocol.troubleshooting: Low recovery: check the flow-through for unbound protein and confirm buffer pH is at least 7.4. High background: increase wash imidazole to 35–40 mM. Precipitation during concentration: keep the sample at 4 °C, reduce centrifugal force, and stop near 2 mg/mL. Poor purity: collect smaller elution fractions and pool only the clean central fractions.
